title: ARPO：熵感知 rollout 分支账（top-10 熵监测与初始熵冻结 + 熵 delta 门控自适应分支 + 不活跃补支 + 回合控制与输出重组）
title_en: ARPO: Entropy-Aware Rollout Branching (Top-10 Entropy Monitoring with Frozen Initial Entropy + Entropy-Delta-Gated Adaptive Beaming + Inactive Refill + Round Control and Output Reorg)
source_lines: vllm_rollout_with_tools.py _calc_entropy + Entropy Variation Monitoring 段 + Entropy-based Adaptive Beaming 段 + 不活跃补支段 + 回合控制段 + 输出重组段
description: ARPO 的核心主张：多轮工具调用 agent RL 中，环境反馈 token 进入上下文后模型分布的不确定性会骤升——把采样预算**在环境反馈后的高熵时刻自适应分叉**，比均匀多采样更省且更强。官方 vllm_rollout_with_tools.py 的确定性账（vLLM 引擎/工具执行器/日志剥除，rollout 输出与随机源全入参），五入口复刻：entropy——逐 rollout 取前 min(20, len(tokens)) 个 token 的 top-10 logprobs 扁平拼接（某 token 缺 logprobs 用最后一个的），熵 = −Σ p·l（p=exp(l)，对 top-k 截断分布求和）、空 → 0，除 log(vocab_size) 归一化，out_idx 首次出现才写 initial_entropy_dict（此后冻结——delta 是对首次观测的漂移）；branch——每样本 remaining_slots = num_samples − rollouts_per_sample（≤0 跳过），每活跃 idx branches_per_idx = min(beam_size − 1, remaining_slots − branches_created)（≤0 break），每分支 prob = clamp(rand() − entropy_weight × (entropy_now − entropy_init), 0, 1)、prob > branch_probability 跳过（熵升 → prob 降 → 更易分支：环境反馈后不确定性升高才分叉；熵降的 rollout 难得分支），分支记 (source_idx, orig_sample)、rps += 1、branches_created 达 remaining_slots 即 break；refill——orig 不在 active_by_sample 且未满 → 每轮只补 1 支、模板取 sample_to_indices[orig][0]（官方用其 init_inputs 重开：curr=init、masks 空、counter 0）；round——工具调用（finish=="stop" 且 stop_reason ∈ stop_sequences）计数器未满 → ("tool", c+1, [])、满额 → ("limit_eos", c, [eos])（追加 EOS 终止），finish=="length" 且 response_len < max_len → continue 否则 stop，EOS → stop；reorg——每样本取前 num_samples 个下标（不足复制最后一个补齐），response = curr_inputs[idx][prompt_len:]，result_masks 逐 token（环境回填段 0、模型生成段 1，由回合账维护、此处透传）。
description_en: ARPO's core claim: in multi-turn tool-call agent RL, the model's distribution uncertainty spikes right after environment feedback enters the context — adaptively branching at those high-entropy moments spends the sampling budget far better than uniform sampling. This problem replicates the deterministic accounting of the official vllm_rollout_with_tools.py (vLLM engine/tool executor/logging stripped, rollout outputs and the random source fully parameterized) via five solve entries: entropy — per rollout, take the first min(20, len(tokens)) tokens' top-10 logprobs flattened (a token missing logprobs falls back to the last one), entropy = −Σ p·l (p=exp(l), over the top-k truncated distribution), empty → 0, normalized by log(vocab_size); out_idx writes initial_entropy_dict only on first sight (frozen afterwards — delta is drift from the first observation); branch — per sample remaining_slots = num_samples − rollouts_per_sample (skip when ≤0), per active idx branches_per_idx = min(beam_size − 1, remaining_slots − branches_created) (break when ≤0), per branch prob = clamp(rand() − entropy_weight × (entropy_now − entropy_init), 0, 1) and prob > branch_probability skips (rising entropy lowers prob → branches more easily: fork right after environment feedback; entropy-falling rollouts rarely branch), branches recorded as (source_idx, orig_sample) with rps += 1 and break at remaining_slots; refill — an orig not in active_by_sample and not yet full gets exactly 1 branch per round, templated from sample_to_indices[orig][0] (the official code restarts from its init_inputs: curr=init, masks empty, counter 0); round — a tool call (finish=="stop" with stop_reason in stop_sequences) under quota returns ("tool", c+1, []), over quota ("limit_eos", c, [eos]) (append EOS to terminate), finish=="length" with response_len < max_len continues otherwise stops, EOS stops; reorg — per sample take the first num_samples indices (duplicating the last one to fill shortfalls), response = curr_inputs[idx][prompt_len:], result_masks per token (environment refill segments 0, model-generated 1, maintained by the round ledger and passed through here).
notes: 官方账的关键细节（沙箱实测钉死）：(1) 熵是 **top-10 截断分布**的 −Σ p·l（logprobs=10 固定）、不是全词表熵——前 20 个 token 的 top-10 拼接后一次求和，token 缺 logprobs 用**最后一个**（vLLM 首 token 边界怪癖）；归一化 log(vocab_size)。(2) initial_entropy_dict 冻结语义：out_idx 首见写入后不再更新——分支门控的 delta 是对首次观测的漂移，跨回合累积。(3) prob 的方向：熵升（delta>0）→ prob 变小 → 更易 ≤ branch_probability → 分支；熵降 → prob 升 → clamp 后更易跳过。rand()−weight×delta 中 rand() 是外层随机源、delta 是确定性调制。(4) 三重上限互锁：remaining_slots（num_samples−rps）封顶总分支数、branches_per_idx=min(beam_size−1, …) 封顶单 idx 分支数、branches_created 达 remaining_slots 即 break——beam_size=1 时 min(0, …)=0 恒无分支。(5) refill 每轮只 1 支且用 init_inputs 模板重开（不是从活跃轨迹续写）——不活跃样本重新冷启动；活跃样本的分支才复制完整上下文。(6) 工具满额不是丢请求而是 append EOS 终止（call_limit_reached 统计）；length 未到 max_len 才 continue。(7) 输出重组的「不足复制最后一个」保证每样本恰好 num_samples 条——分支预算的下限兜底。(8) 与论文公式的对应：官方代码的熵是 top-10 近似、token 窗口 20 固定，与论文"环境反馈 token 的后验熵"的表述有实现偏差——以代码为准。与 to-grpo-advantage 划界：ARPO 的预算分配发生在 rollout 侧（样本数向高熵分支倾斜），advantage 侧仍是组内标准化；本题只收 rollout 侧账。
notes_en: Key official details (pinned by sandbox runs): (1) the entropy is the −Σ p·l of a **top-10 truncated distribution** (logprobs=10 fixed), not full-vocab entropy — the first 20 tokens' top-10 lists are flattened and summed once, a token missing logprobs falls back to the **last** one (a vLLM first-token edge quirk); normalized by log(vocab_size). (2) initial_entropy_dict is frozen: written on first sight only — the branch gate's delta is drift from the first observation, accumulating across rounds. (3) The prob direction: rising entropy (delta>0) lowers prob → branches more easily; falling entropy raises prob → skips after clamp. rand() − weight×delta where rand() is the outer random source and delta the deterministic modulation. (4) Three caps interlock: remaining_slots (num_samples−rps) caps total branches, branches_per_idx = min(beam_size−1, …) caps per-idx branches, and branches_created reaching remaining_slots breaks — with beam_size=1, min(0, …)=0 means no branch ever. (5) Refill adds exactly 1 branch per round and restarts from the init_inputs template (not a continuation of an active trajectory) — inactive samples cold-restart; only branches of active samples copy full context. (6) Hitting the tool quota appends EOS rather than dropping the request (the call_limit_reached counter); length continues only below max_len. (7) The reorg's "duplicate the last to fill" guarantees exactly num_samples outputs per sample — the floor of the branching budget. (8) Mapping to the paper: the official entropy is a top-10 approximation with a fixed 20-token window, deviating from the paper's "posterior entropy of environment-feedback tokens" phrasing — the code is authoritative. Boundary vs to-grpo-advantage: ARPO's budget allocation happens on the rollout side (sample counts tilt toward high-entropy branches); the advantage side remains group-normalized, and this problem covers only the rollout-side ledger.
